description:
Virtual queue for hot on-sales with fair ordering, purchase limits (per customer/card/event), rate limiting and suspicious-order flagging.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Queue admits fairly (no line-jumping) and meters load into checkout
- Purchase limits enforce at checkout across guest/account identities
- Abuse signals flag orders for staff review without blocking legitimate buyers

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).
